visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with braided pigtails, wearing a grey graphic t-shirt and jeans, stands in a brightly lit medical clinic or studio room. She points her finger directly into the camera lens with an energetic and inquisitive expression. Large text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear on the screen with white radiation-style lines emphasizing her. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a male doctor wearing blue medical scrubs standing behind a green partition. He gestures with his right hand as he speaks, maintaining a professional yet approachable facial expression. The background features clinical equipment and bright white lighting. (3) A full-screen informational graphic appears, showing male and female silhouettes alongside statistical percentages (91.3% and 84.6%) and text regarding HPV infection rates. (4) The camera returns to the doctor in a medium shot; he continues to speak while folding his arms and then pointing, providing detailed health information. (5) The woman returns to the frame, pointing once more and moving her body with high energy. Her facial expressions vary from serious to questioning as she delivers a message. (6) A new colorful infographic is displayed, promoting free HPV vaccinations for junior high school boys in Taipei, featuring cartoon illustrations and QR codes. (7) The doctor explains further in a medium shot, using hand gestures to emphasize costs and insurance comparisons. (8) A table-style graphic compares the cost of HPV vaccines over ten years versus the uncertainty of cancer insurance payouts. (9) The woman concludes the video with a series of fast-cut close-ups, ending with her laughing and smiling broadly towards the camera in a friendly manner.
